# plotrr

Research software · R package

Look within groups.

We built plotrr to help inspect relationships within groups before
fitting a model to the pooled data.

[Get started ↗](#quick-start)[See the functions
→](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/index.md)

Charles Crabtree and Michael J. Nelson

[![plotrr: Human – AI (editor)
👤✏️🤖](reference/figures/provenance.svg)](https://thelatentreview.com/provenance/)

**Initial versions: entirely human-created.** AI was used only for later
updates and code fixes.

## Quick start

``` r
install.packages("plotrr")
library(plotrr)

# One bivariate plot for each cylinder group.
bivarplots("wt", "mpg", "cyl", mtcars)
```

For the development version, use
`remotes::install_github("lobsterbush/plotrr")`.

## Explore within groups

A relationship in the whole sample can look different within a country
or school. We use these plots to see which groups follow the pattern and
which ones need a closer look.

| Task | Function |
|----|----|
| Compare two measures within each group | [`bivarplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/bivarplots.md) |
| Inspect distributions as histograms | [`histplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/histplots.md) |
| Compare distributions as violins | [`violinplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/violinplots.md) |
| Make group-specific dot plots | [`dotplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/dotplots.md) |
| Plot a relationship with marginal rugs | [`bivarrugplot()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/bivarrugplot.md) |

Pass column names as strings and supply a data frame. Functions that
produce several plots print each plot in turn; consult the reference for
each signature.

## Provenance

**Human – AI (editor) 👤✏️🤖**

We wrote every initial version ourselves, without AI. We’ve used AI only
for later updates and code fixes. I’m Charles Crabtree, and this is my
account of how the package was made.

The label and mark follow [The Latent Review’s provenance
standard](https://thelatentreview.com/provenance/), shared under [CC BY
4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The software remains
MIT licensed.

## Help and development

If something isn’t working, please tell us in the [issue
tracker](https://github.com/lobsterbush/plotrr/issues). The [source and
README](https://github.com/lobsterbush/plotrr) include installation
requirements and local documentation build instructions.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bivarplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/bivarplots.md)
  : Plot two variables within each group
- [`bivarrugplot()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/bivarrugplot.md)
  : Draw a scatterplot with marginal rugs
- [`clear()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/clear.md) :
  Clear the console display
- [`dotplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/dotplots.md)
  : Draw a dot plot for each group
- [`histplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/histplots.md)
  : Draw a histogram for each group
- [`lengthunique()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/lengthunique.md)
  : Count distinct non-missing values
- [`makefacnum()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/makefacnum.md)
  : Convert numeric factor labels to numbers
- [`violinplots()`](https://lobsterbush.github.io/plotrr/reference/violinplots.md)
  : Draw violin plots within each group
